faqs.a:
(a)
A person commits impersonating a public servant if he falsely pretends to be a public
               servant other than a peace officer and performs any act in that pretended capacity.
(b)
It is no defense to a prosecution under this section that the office the person pretended
               to hold in fact did not exist.
(Code 1960, §§ 17-20, 17-23; Code 1981, §§ 21-18, 21-19)
State Law reference—
Impersonating a public servant, C.R.S. §§ 18-8-112, 18-8-113.
